title: OffensiveCon19 - Alex Ionescu - Keynote - Reversing Without Reversing
summary: Alex Ionescu's OffensiveCon 2019 keynote on how reverse engineering is done on Windows without conventional reversing. It covers legal ways to obtain names of variables, exported functions and structures.
why: Cited in ReactOS threads as an authoritative account of how Windows reverse engineering works and as a rebuttal to claims about ReactOS.

quote.text: I'd recommend watching Alex Ionescu's talk at OffensiveCon about how he does reverse engineering on Windows
